committee_objections.would_clear: Trigger h1_close_above:bar_high on H1: an hourly close above yesterday's high, the fresh new high (C5).

committee_objections.objection: Trigger in_zone:ma_20 still buys the pullback itself, the anticipation not the breakout (C5). With D close_vs_swing_high_pct 8.52 and W 20.49 price is far past any pivot (R5); a touch of ma_20 alone is not a buy on my method. The floor gave no evidence my method weighs to keep it.
committee_objections.would_clear: Trigger h1_close_above:bar_high on H1 after a fresh tight pause on volume drying below average (C6): the break of the new base, not the touch of ma_20.

committee_objections.objection: The slate still carries in_zone:ma_20: a buy into a pullback with no volume test. C21 pyramids into strength only and C16 needs volume on the break; a Rank 2 rs LEADER at a new high on day_vol 3.41, dist_to_20bar_high_pct 0.46, is a strength entry.
committee_objections.would_clear: Trigger becomes h1_close_above:bar_high on day_vol 1.40+, no add-ons (D close_vs_swing_high_pct 8.52 is a C17 late buy).

committee_objections.objection: Trigger in_zone:ma_20 buys a dip on a position-system break to new highs (W and D HH/HL, dist_to_20bar_high_pct 0.46); there strength is the entry (C26), and a 20MA touch alone is not my five-condition swing set-up (C3). The floor gave no evidence my method weighs to keep it.
committee_objections.would_clear: Trigger h1_close_above:bar_high (my trade_above:bar_high on a finer clock): buy over yesterday's high, trailed to each new prior-day high (C27).

committee_objections.objection: Trigger in_zone:ma_20 is still not a trading zone on my method. At D close_vs_swing_high_pct 8.52 price is away from value; the entry is the test of the broken Creek, then a sign-of-strength follow-through (C3, C7, C12, R2). Nothing on the floor changed that.
committee_objections.would_clear: Trigger in_zone:structure_shift_ref on D (the test of the broken Creek), then h1_close_above:bar_high there as the follow-through; wrong if a D close back under structure_shift_ref.

committee_objections.would_clear: A fresh permission transition (a bar of 6 or lower then 7 or above) with the trigger in_zone:ma_20 on D.

committee_objections.objection: D close_vs_swing_high_pct 30.04 is far past any pivot: more than 10% extended is a hard rejection (C17). A short pause then an hourly close over yesterday's high is not a measurable base or pivot (C18), and the trigger carries no breakout-volume test (C16).
committee_objections.would_clear: A new base (flat base 5-6 weeks, C18) forms above ma_50 and the trigger becomes close_above:pivot_high on day_vol 1.40 or more.

committee_objections.objection: The trigger adds a precondition ('after a tight pause on drying volume') my position system does not have; D close_vs_swing_high_pct 30.04 at new highs is the buy signal itself (C26), and a mechanical system takes it as generated (C31).
committee_objections.would_clear: Drop the pause precondition: h1_close_above:bar_high (or trade_above:bar_high) acted on from today's session (C27).

committee_objections.objection: Trigger h1_close_above:bar_high at D close_vs_swing_high_pct 30.04 buys a move running away from value; my method waits for the corrective wave into a trading zone (C3, C15, R2).
committee_objections.would_clear: Trigger in_zone:vwap_14d on D: the pullback into 14-day value first, then the sign-of-strength bar there.
